description: The newest arXiv submissions in any category (cs.AI, cs.CL, q-bio.GN, stat.ML, ...), optionally filtered by keywords: titles, authors, summaries, links, papers per day and trending terms. Needs a Quill Research Pass (1 USDC = 24 h, 5 USDC = 7 days, 15 USDC = 30 days by plain USDC transfer on Base; see payment_options), or pay per call over HTTP x402 ($0.02) at /v1/arxiv/latest.

cat.description: arXiv category, e.g. cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.LG, cs.CV, stat.ML, q-bio.GN, quant-ph (default cs.AI).

pass.description: Optional Quill Research Pass token (qp1...). Better: set it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

q.description: Optional keywords that must appear in title or abstract (e.g. "agents tool use").

name: arxiv_latest
title: Latest arXiv papers
